title: Item:Elixir of Healing
wikitext:
__NOTOC__{{Top}} Elixirs of Healing provide a large instant burst of healing, followed by a heal-over-time effect that continues to heal for ten seconds. Functions equally well on living creatures, constructs (warforged), and undead (pale masters) who use them. {| class="wikitable sortable" style="margin: 1em auto; text-align: center; width: 50%; border: 1px solid;" |- ! style="background:#AACCFF;"| Item ! style="background:#AACCFF;"| Description |- | [[#Elixir of Lesser Healing|Elixir of Lesser Healing]] || Immediately heal 10 Hit Points, plus 2 to 4 additional Hit Points every 2 seconds for the next 10 seconds (20 - 30 HP in total). |- | [[#Elixir of Moderate Healing|Elixir of Moderate Healing]] || Immediately heal 20 Hit Points, plus 4 to 8 additional Hit Points every 2 seconds for the next 10 seconds (40 - 60 HP in total). |- | [[#Elixir of Improved Healing|Elixir of Improved Healing]] || Immediately heal 30 Hit Points, plus 6 to 12 additional Hit Points every 2 seconds for the next 10 seconds (60 - 90 HP in total). |- | [[#Elixir of Greater Healing|Elixir of Greater Healing]] || Immediately heal 50 Hit Points, plus 10 to 20 additional Hit Points every 2 seconds for the next 10 seconds (100 - 150 HP in total). |-class="sortbottom" | colspan="2" | ''See also: {{Item|Gold Seal Elixir of Healing}}, [[Daily Dice]], [[DDOstore/Healing|DDO Store:Healing]] for cost and quantities'' |} == Regular vs Gold Seal elixirs == * Availability - Some of the stronger elixirs are only available in the Gold Seal variant. * Binding - Regular elixirs are unbound, Gold Seal variety binds to account. * Cooldown - Regular elixirs have a cooldown period of 30 seconds; it's halved to 15 seconds for Gold Seal elixirs. * Minimum level - The minimum level increases with elixirs' potency for regular elixirs; all Gold Seal elixirs are ML:1. * Weight - Gold Seal elixirs have no weight == Elixir of Lesser Healing == {{Consumable |picdesc = Elixir of Lesser Healing.png |acquired = [[Collectables]] |location = |turnin =
